title: Each type in a rishta meeting (respectful)
caption:
The rishta meeting, as told by the 16 types. Respectfully.

Some arrive with three thoughtful questions. Some rehearse for days and forget everything. Some quietly make sure the elders get their chai first. Every type brings something good to the table, along with the samosas.

Send this to someone with a family meeting coming up this season. Best of luck to them.

Which one would you be?
